description: The 401 a sidecar sends when it refuses a service token. Body: the Fancy error envelope (fancy-http-errors envelope.schema.json), exactly {error, message, requestId}. The reason travels in WWW-Authenticate, never in the body. Pinned by SHA-256 in the Python and Node legs, so the sentences below are identical in both by test result.

messages.missing: This request carries no service token.
messages.malformed: The service token could not be read.
messages.bad_signature: The service token signature does not match a known key.
messages.not_yet_valid: The service token is not valid yet.
messages.wrong_audience: The service token was issued for a different service.
messages.replayed: The service token has already been used.
